title: Samurai Shodown II
note: Neo Geo fighting game: health, timer, score, 17 characters.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x80, inside the fighter object (address read at 0x100A46)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x80, inside the fighter object (address read at 0x100A4A)

score.note: player 1 score, found with learn.bat. Inside the fighter object (address read at 0x100A46), copied again every round. A brief 0 between two fights is ignored for 20 seconds

score_p2.note: player 2 score, same place as for player 1, to be confirmed in a two-player game. Inside the fighter object (address read at 0x100A4A), copied again every round. A brief 0 between two fights is ignored for 20 seconds

backdrop.note: backdrop of the fight (cheat database "Select Backdrop"): 0 Haohmaru, 1 Nakoruru, 2 Hanzo, 3 Galford, 4 Wan-Fu, 5 Ukyo, 6 Kyoshiro, 7 Gen-An, 8 Earthquake, 9 Jubei, 10 (unused), 11 Charlotte, 12 Genjuro, 13 Cham Cham, 14 Sieger, 15 Nicotine, 16 Mizuki, 17 Kuroko. Picks the HD theme in "hd": "stages"

hd.note: HD screen theme for each backdrop value (index = value), see README, HD themes
